title: Iowa’s 2026 incoming class, by the numbers
summary_en: The University of Iowa’s 2026 incoming class marks the fifth consecutive first-year class of more than 5,000 students and again is among the largest in university history. It’s also one of the highest achieving, with an average high school grade-point average of 3.87. Read more about our newest Hawkeyes.
title_cn: Iowa’s 2026 incoming class, by the numbers

title: UI Health Care shifting focus to more quickly expand access to care for Iowans
summary_en: UI Health Care is revising its facilities strategy to more quickly expand access to care for Iowans. By modernizing and expanding existing spaces instead of building a new hospital tower, the health system expects to add about 100 patient beds and serve an estimated 23,000 patients sooner.
title_cn: UI Health Care shifting focus to more quickly expand access to care for Iowans

title: UI outlines strategy for artificial intelligence
summary_en: The University of Iowa is building a campuswide strategy for artificial intelligence to coordinate and strengthen efforts across teaching, research, and public engagement. This approach will focus on three core components that connect the entire campus: engaging across disciplines, ensuring responsible expertise, and amplifying human potential.
title_cn: UI outlines strategy for artificial intelligence

title: Campus can submit proposals for FY 2028 P3 funding
summary_en: Proposals are now being accepted for fiscal year 2028 P3 projects that support the University of Iowa’s 2022-2027 Strategic Plan. Preliminary proposals must be submitted by Nov. 13.
title_cn: Campus can submit proposals for FY 2028 P3 funding

title: New 9/11 documentary highlights Iowa alumna’s role in rebuilding ground zero
summary_en: A new documentary, 9/11: Reclaiming Ground Zero, tells how UI alumna Carolyn Lukensmeyer and AmericaSpeaks brought 5,000 New Yorkers together to help shape the rebuilding of ground zero. The film, executive produced by Lukensmeyer, emphasizes citizen engagement — something she says she learned the importance of during her time at Iowa.
title_cn: New 9/11 documentary highlights Iowa alumna’s role in rebuilding ground zero
